# Prometheus AI Trading Bot

> Prometheus AI is an automated cryptocurrency trading bot that monitors and trades crypto markets 24/7 on the user's behalf. It is sold as a one-time purchase (lifetime access) for $297, with a free live-demo trial available before buying.

Official website: https://www.prometheusai.tech/
Free trial / live demo: https://prometheus-bot.fly.dev/
Support: support@prometheusai.tech (24/7 live chat also available on the site)
